text:
Priyanka (CS): quick flag — NymoHealth onboarding showing p95 tail increases on /v1/chat (p95 up ~520ms over last 36h). Renewal check-in in 3 days. proposing a low-risk hedge: route short clinician responses to redwood-sparrow-3B-int8 (quantized) and keep gpu-13B for long context. want a brief canary + offline QA on clinician_brief_suite.

Omar (Solutions): can you share p50/p95 and avg token length? also need a representative prompt to re-run the eval.

Priyanka (CS): p50 ~230ms, p95 ~1050ms, avg payload ~130 tokens; sample prompt: `Summarize the visit and list immediate follow-ups for the care team`. many are multi-section notes but a lot of quick triage messages too.

Sam (SRE): any correlation with KV cache misses or ingestion spikes?

Priyanka (CS): spikes line up with the nightly batch import at 02:20 UTC and a preview surge around 11:00 UTC. those windows blow the prefix cache. routing short requests off the heavy runtime should tighten the tail.

Omar (Solutions): suggested plan: 1) run offline eval on clinician_brief_suite measuring entity-F1, ROUGE, and hallucination flags; 2) routing rule: prefer redwood-sparrow-3B-int8 when request.tokens <= 700; if request.headers["x-long-context"]=="true" route to gpu-13B; 3) canary 10% for 12h; 4) auto-rollback if feedback rate >2% in 30m or automated hallucination >1%.

Lena (Customer): clinicians want a lightweight feedback button with reason options (missing follow-up / wrong med / other). auto-rollback required for clinician-facing flows. can you surface flagged examples to our team?

Sam (SRE): will stand up canary and wire rollback. setting thresholds: feedback_thresh=0.02, evaluation_window=30m. also will temporarily rate-limit batch-import concurrency during the canary window to reduce KV thrash.

Omar (Solutions): sample Redwood Console routing config (pseudo-yaml):
```yaml
rules:
  - name: sparrow-short-pref
    match: path == "/v1/chat" and request.tokens <= 700
    prefer: redwood-sparrow-3B-int8
    fallback: gpu-13B
    canary_percent: 10
    window: 12h
    auto_rollback_on_feedback: true
```

Priyanka (CS): assigning follow-ups: @Omar run the offline eval and post artifacts; @Sam provision canary infra + auto-rollback; @Lena enable feedback toggle and confirm clinicians can submit a short reason. i'll add a short remediation note to the renewal packet.

bot-canary: Canary created: canary-8421112223. Observability: https://console.redwood/example/canary/canary-8421112223

Sam (SRE): canary live. initial streaming metrics: canary p95=460ms, baseline p95=1030ms. quick sample QA (n=20): 3 phrasing-only diffs, no entity errors. feedback widget enabled.

Omar (Solutions): early estimates: routed p95 down ~55% and token-cost for those requests down ~44%. if offline eval shows entity-F1 delta <1.5% and hallucination <0.8% we recommend ramp to 50% over 24h.

Lena (Customer): feedback toggle live. clinicians flagged 2 style items so far (reason: missing detail). asked to auto-send flagged examples to our QA channel.

Sam (SRE): auto-rollback not triggered. feedback rate ~0.9% in first 4h. streaming logs to #cs-renewals. will keep ingestion caps active during warm windows.

Omar (Solutions): offline eval finished: entity-F1 delta -0.6%, ROUGE drop 0.8, automated hallucination 0.3% (within guardrails). attaching artifacts to renewal packet and drafting a one-slide summary for the renewal call.

Priyanka (CS): renewal note: "Proactive performance mitigation started: 10% canary to redwood-sparrow-3B-int8 reduced p95 on routed traffic and projects ~40% token-cost savings; quality within thresholds. recommended ramp plan attached." will add flagged examples to the packet.

Lena (Customer): this looks good — please proceed cautiously and keep the clinicians' feedback button on during the ramp. thanks for the proactive fix.

Sam (SRE): plan: ramp to 50% in 12h if metrics remain stable; keep auto-rollback thresholds and ingestion throttles. will post ramp progress here. :rocket:
